description: Flyvis-FlyWire hybrid connectome inference, model trained on full_eye_flywireRF receptive fields with group-lasso regularization, 10 of 10 runs landed.
facts:
CAPTION: Hybrid Flyvis–FlyWire connectome model inference. (a) Hybrid model combining the Flyvis convolutional template (represented by orange disc, extent 8) with the FlyWire FAFB- v783 column lattice (teal disc) on the right hemisphere; 3D oblique view, right optic-lobe with representative registered visual neurons through lamina, medulla, lobula, and lobula plate neuropil meshes. Orange discs indicate “e8 hybrid” columns, scatter points indicate synapse positions, circles indicate 6 µm edge confusion radius around synapse clouds. (b) In contrast to Flyvis template connectivity (Supplementary Supp. Fig. 12), per-column FlyWire receptive-field connectivity for an example projection (Tm3 →T4c): Each mini-hexlattice is the spatial RF kernel of one T4c target column at the location (p, q) ∈{(0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), · · · } (extent 1), with input cells annotated by per-edge synapse count. Cells lacki
FACTS:
- experiment: 7: FlyWire hybrids: Known ODE and GNN
- arm: condl25
- runs: 10 of 10 landed
- cells: variant: full_eye_flywireRF_noise_005, full_eye_flywireRF_proximal_nulls_noise_005
- dataset: full_eye_flywireRF_noise_005_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_conductance
- embedding dim: 2
- model noise sigma: 0.05
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 500
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 0.00015, W_L2 1.5e-06, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.28, f_theta_weight_L1 0.05
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
